product.summary: Brave browser-native self-custody wallet surface available within supported Brave desktop and mobile browsers.
product.notes: Modeled as one browser-integrated wallet product rather than a browser extension because Brave explicitly states no extension is required. Initial release date remains unresolved.

events.title: Browser-native Brave Wallet launched
events.description: Brave launched a browser-native self-custody wallet built directly into the Brave desktop browser, replacing extension dependence for Brave's primary built-in wallet path while allowing users to import from the legacy Crypto Wallets extension.
events.notes: This is retained as material product-history depth because Brave explicitly introduced a new browser-native wallet boundary with no extension required and documented migration/import from its legacy Crypto Wallets extension. It is not a generic launch added solely to reduce the zero-event count. Mobile availability was still future-facing in this launch announcement and is not included in the affected product scope.

evidence.title: What is Brave Wallet?
evidence.notes: First-party help center confirms browser-native self-custody and desktop/mobile usage.

evidence.title: Introducing the Brave Wallet, a Browser-Native Crypto Wallet With No Extension Required
evidence.notes: First-party Brave launch post states that Brave Wallet launched on 2021-11-16 as a browser-native desktop wallet requiring no extension and documents import from Brave's legacy Crypto Wallets extension.

evidence.title: Brave Wallet
evidence.notes: Current first-party Brave Wallet page documents the built-in browser wallet, desktop/mobile availability and continuing compatibility improvements, supporting active maintenance. Initial release date remains unresolved in this bundle.
